title: The Deliberative Illusion: Diagnosing Factual Attrition and Stance Homogenization in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring stance entropy across multi-agent discussion rounds to evaluate how diverse initial positions collapse into a homogenized consensus, often at the expense of issue-critical facts.

Comparing the final multi-agent majority stance against the direct base-model's zero-shot output using Match Rate and Brier Score to determine if the consensus merely reflects the underlying model's inherent prior tendency rather than integrated evidence.
